name: camca-inhaler-eval
description: Camera-based Automated Multi-agent Clinical Assessment of Inhaler Technique. 4-layer hybrid: MediaPipe+librosa telemetry → dual-agent VLM evaluation → Cohen kappa adjudication → deterministic scoring. v0.4.1: device-specific audio profiles + VLM-telemetry reconciliation + false-positive guards. MVP: pMDI + DPI Turbuhaler.
